assumptions: ParseProblem.message is the error code (PARSE_NO_EQUALS / PARSE_BAD_KEY / PARSE_UNCLOSED_QUOTE) followed by a short description; the spec fixes no message text
the export prefix is the literal 'export ' (one space) after trimming the line; a bare 'export' line with no = is a PARSE_NO_EQUALS problem
a value counts as quoted only when its first character after trimming is a quote; a quote mid-value (a"b) is literal
a lone quote as the whole value (A=") is an unclosed quote
no escape processing inside quotes and inline # after = kept in the value (PD-4, PD-5)
the test file reads src/parse.mjs with node:fs to check its imports; the purity invariant applies to the module, not to its test
